Jane Doe (witness): That's correct. I was never the CEO.

Jane Doe (witness): I joined the company in 2010 as a senior executive.
Attorney Smith (attorney): Thank you. That's all for now.

I recall that Meridian Construction was actually founded in 2010, much later than they claim. When James Carter became CEO in 2019, things changed rapidly. During my time there, I worked as a Senior Safety Analyst, a role I took very seriously. I eventually resigned in August 2023 due to safety concerns. I heard that James Carter was fired from Meridian in 2022, though I cannot confirm it. Regarding Project Atlas, I am certain it started on July 1, 2022, because I was there on day one. Everyone knows the headquarters of Meridian are located in Seattle.

Meridian Construction was founded in 2005 by a group of engineers. James Carter is the CEO of Meridian Construction. The company employs 500 people across three offices. Sarah Miller was hired as a Safety Inspector in March 2020. The project was completed on time and under budget. The founding of Meridian Construction took place in 2005. James Carter serves as Chief Executive Officer at Meridian Construction. 500 employees work for the company in three different locations. Sarah Miller joined Meridian as Safety Inspector in spring 2020. The project finished by the deadline without exceeding the allocated budget.

James Carter attended the board meeting on March 5th. The safety report was submitted to the city inspector. Sarah Miller confirmed the accuracy of the financial statements. The defendant was present at the construction site that day. The company approved the budget for Project Atlas. James Carter did not attend the board meeting on March 5th. The safety report was never submitted to the city inspector. Sarah Miller denied the accuracy of the financial statements. The defendant was absent from the construction site that day. The company rejected the budget for Project Atlas.

Meridian Construction employs 500 people. The contract was valued at $2.5 million. The building has 15 stories. Revenue increased by 25% in fiscal year 2023. The project required 18 months to complete. Meridian Construction has only 50 employees. The contract was worth $250,000. The building is 40 floors tall. Revenue declined by 10% in 2023. The project was completed in just 6 months.

Meridian Construction was founded in 2005 by a group of engineers. James Carter became CEO of Meridian on January 15, 2018. The merger was finalized on December 31, 2021. The safety inspection was conducted in Q1 2023. Meridian Construction was established in 2010. James Carter took over as CEO in March 2019. The merger was completed in early 2022. The safety inspection occurred in Q4 2023.

Meridian Construction was founded in 2005. James Carter became CEO in January 2018. The company headquarters is located in Seattle, Washington. Project Atlas began construction on June 10, 2022. The weather in Chicago was unusually cold last winter. Sarah Miller enjoys hiking on weekends. The stock market experienced volatility in Q3 2023. New environmental regulations were passed by Congress. The cafeteria serves lunch from 11am to 2pm daily.

COMPLAINT FOR DAMAGES. Maria Lopez ("Plaintiff") brings this action against Green Valley Logistics, Inc. (the "Company") and Daniel Reed (hereafter "Defendant"). Acme Holdings LLC, hereinafter referred to as the Landlord, leased the warehouse at 200 Mission Street to Jane Doe, hereinafter "Tenant", on March 4, 2023. "Buyer" is defined as Global Traders LLC. Judge Alan Brown ("Court") presided. Smith and Jones ("Plaintiffs") joined the suit. Riverside Insurance Company (the "Insurer") denied coverage of $14,250.00.
